summary: Provides descriptor_invariants_for(registry) — a factory that returns a parametrised pytest class covering all descriptors in the given Registry. Each registered descriptor automatically gets invariant checks: name is lowercase, parameter names are UPPERCASE, driver_keys are unique, auth_modes are non-empty AuthSpec subclasses, and provider_type is not None.
lifecycle_notes: pytest is a lazy import — keeps the module importable in non-test environments
Returns a dynamically named class: TestDescriptorInvariants_{registry.name}
documentation_hooks: Drop `TestMyInvariants = descriptor_invariants_for(MY_REGISTRY)` into any test module to get free coverage of all registered descriptors
